scope: The original inventory and its productionTree are retained. The focused native-routes supplement advances six complete host wrappers and the prefix of normal startup. Physical-device and independent visual approval remain open.

routes.notConstructed: Board reset assembly, physical/linker addresses, successful flash ID and native storage recovery, IRQ delivery, audio bring-up and the normal main loop after the crash notice.
routes.displayEvidence: Complete fm1_cstart over private linker regions enters the original fm1_main RAM-only prefix and safe_main on simulated failed starts. Default boot and both post-crash notices match the archived frames. Four consecutive failures exit to the modeled updater before LCD initialization.

routes.notConstructed: CPU exception delivery, actual clock duration and physical reboot.
routes.displayEvidence: The complete fault function draws its diagnostics, polls its timer and requests a host reset. Its framebuffer matches the archived diagnostic.

routes.notConstructed: The native watchdog, USB, physical PLAY retry, detach and reset are outside host qualification.
routes.displayEvidence: The full safe_main function handles held PLAY across its time guard and a modeled USB bootloader request. Both core cases, prompted retry and the resulting endpoints are checked.

routes.notConstructed: Physical USB detach and actual bootloader transition.
routes.displayEvidence: The complete function executes both direct and USB-request paths, checks detach/delays, clears pending in RAM and reaches the modeled bootloader endpoint.

routes.notConstructed: Electrical matrix/encoder acquisition, physical elapsed time and persistent device storage.
routes.displayEvidence: The complete calibration function consumes simulated button edges and encoder turns. All 21 prompts, three timeout/rollback paths, successful RAM persistence and the final clear are checked.

routes.notConstructed: Native LCD power/reset and hardware bus initialization.
routes.displayEvidence: The production lcd_init, lcd_window, lcd_data, lcd_fill and lcd_blit run against a RAM SPI endpoint; bounds, pixel counts, clear and display-on are checked.

routes.notConstructed: The firmware drum part and mix dispatch use the dedicated drum painter or a DG_LEVEL strip. Neither selects the generic matrix drum-value fitter or the DG_DECAY/DG_NTAIL tail on admitted drum pages.
routes.displayEvidence: The admitted drum part route uses draw_drum_voice; ordinary strip drum dispatch selects DG_LEVEL. These helpers remain unobserved, not synthetically invoked to inflate coverage.

routes.notConstructed: No single admitted non-performance control preview on any Chicago/Miami factory cell selected this fallback. Combined valid previews and physical devices remain outside this sweep.
routes.displayEvidence: A malformed sibling cutoff lock exercises the real projector rejection and fallback on a full Chicago oscillator page. Painter elision localizes 43 pixels. See native-routes/wave-frame.json.

routes.notConstructed: The generic bank footer has no physical dispatch with these parameters on the admitted bass pages.
routes.displayEvidence: describe_pages emits sound/bank controls under V_PART. draw_knobs returns after draw_part_sound for that view; the V_SEQ preset uses R_BPATSND. See native-routes/README.md.

otherHelpers: The report and stable-ID table retain every additional unobserved function classified NO_DIRECT_CALL_PATH_REVIEW_REQUIRED; that classification does not prove absence of callbacks or macro reachability.

sourceCoverage.scope: Original 1,712-frame run; supplemental execution is listed separately.
